## Page pg1

After losing a close game a day after Thanksgiving, they were awarded with district honors. The Leopards had a great season of pride and determination. Even through the highs and lows, their goal stayed the same. That no matter what happens, they’re a family. 
1 Brayson Beck - District MVP
2 Colby Cook - 1st Team WR, 2nd Team LB 
3 Miles Clark - Honorable Mention WR, 1st Team CB
4 Parker Liles - 2nd Team WR, 1st Team OLB
6 Camden Hendrix - 2nd Team CB
7 Avin Madrid - 1st Team TE, Honorable Mention DE
8 Bransen Beckham - HM LB
12 Hunter Burrell - 1st Team LB
13 Carson Hendrix - 2nd Team FB
15 Keegan Adams - Honorable Mention DE
17 Kaden McDonald - 2nd Team K
18 Ryder Starkey - Offensive MVP, 1st Team LB, 1st Team Punter 
20 Hayden Reyna - Utility Player of the Year 
21 Lincoln Preston - 1st Team RB, 1st Team Safety 
22 Marshall Brown - Newcomer of the Year
50 Haden Brumley - Defensive MVP
52 Kenny Donald - 2nd Team Guard 
54 Greyson Snell - 2nd Team DL
55 Keaton Bullard - Offensive Line MVP
58 Rafe Richardson - Honorable Mention Guard 
60 Harrison Heatwole - 1st Team Guard, 1st Team DL 
65 Zack Sellers - 1st Team Tackle, Honorable Mention DL
31 players recieved Academic All-District Honors. Congratulations to our Football team for another great year of Leopard Football!
